family: all primary direction-rows WITHIN SITE, lung and brain separately (ADR 0021 §6). A null built at n = 13 cannot be applied to n = 8. Both directions of an interaction sit in the same family.
gate: This is the task Gate 4 turns on.
gate_rule: Gate 4 passes if the empirical FDR is computed and honoured. A surviving list and an EMPTY list both pass; a ranked list without a null does not. Nothing downstream may reach past it for a softer threshold.

null_a.what_is_permuted: the pairing — which patient's immune AOI is matched to which patient's tumour AOI — within site, so both n's are preserved exactly. Each gene's values, distribution, abundance and detection are untouched.

null_b.pool: genes reaching an admitted interaction in that compartment — the same admission rule as the real partners, so the comparison is like-for-like. 'Among ligands and receptors of this abundance' is the question a nomination has to beat.
null_b.role: qualifies a nomination. NOT a second gate, creates no second FDR family; a row that clears A but not B is reported as such, never removed.
null_b.what_is_drawn: random gene pairs from the same mean-expression decile as the real tumour-side and immune-side partners, with the TRUE pairing intact. Drawn once per (decile, decile) cell — the null depends only on the decile pair.

reporting_rule: A null is an ASSAY-SENSITIVITY LIMIT, never evidence that the crosstalk is absent (ADR 0014). TIME-B n = 8 (hard constraint 8). 'no LR pair exceeded chance expectation at n=13' is an honest result and passes this gate.
